items.computation: The invoice is dated 20.11.2026 and the payment period runs '14 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum' (14 days from the invoice date). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period is reckoned from an event (the invoice date) occurring on a given day, that day is not counted; the period starts on 21.11.2026. Counting 14 days: 21.11., 22.11., 23.11., 24.11., 25.11., 26.11., 27.11., 28.11., 29.11., 30.11., 01.12., 02.12., 03.12., 04.12.2026 — the 14th day is 04.12.2026. Checking the weekday: today 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday, so 28.11. is Saturday, 29.11. is Sunday, and 04.12.2026 falls on a Friday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in NRW, so no extension under § 193 BGB is needed.
